note: Updated to three-benchmark structure (Phase 2 redesign). Previous single-number format was misleading because Groq generation was excluded without being explicitly labelled.

benchmark_a_fast_path.description: Fast-path RAG: normalize -> guardrails -> embed -> retrieve -> extractive -> grounding_extractive -> response. This is the <200ms SLA path. Groq excluded.

benchmark_b_llm_enhanced.description: LLM-enhanced pipeline: same as A + Groq generation (openai/gpt-oss-20b) + full grounding verifier with sentence embeddings. Reported honestly.

generation_groq.note: Groq free-tier openai/gpt-oss-20b. Varies with API load. Measured via isolated runs; not included in latency_results.csv which was collected without live Groq calls.

rag_core_total.note: Approximate: embedding + retrieval + generation_groq + grounding_full. Groq numbers are from isolated measurements.

benchmark_c_voice_e2e.description: Voice E2E = Sarvam STT (network round-trip) + Benchmark A RAG core. STT is always reported separately in LatencyMetrics.stt_ms.
benchmark_c_voice_e2e.note: STT latency is a network property, not a RAG core property. Never combined with A or B numbers.
